g.text: The Component view of the Webshop Monolith: its remaining business modules (ADR-0002); Order and Payments moved to the Order Service (ADR-0007), which calls Catalog and Customer Accounts over JSON/HTTPS and talks to Inventory only through events on the Message Broker (ADR-0006).
